title: Why Every AI Website Looks the Same (And How to Fix It)
description:
Purple gradients, rounded cards, emoji icons. Every AI coded site looks identical because your prompt has zero design opinion. Vibe Curve fixes this, free and open source on GitHub. Strict rule files that force the agent to extract real design signals before building, then kill anything that smells like AI purple.
